Tekkaman Blade Plastic Model series is now available in premium coating version! !
The Tekkaman Plaid Plastic Model series was released in 1992, and the character and plastic model product specifications were
Its affinity has been accepted by many fans and it has become very popular. This plastic model series is in production for the first time in 12!

In addition to regular plating, we also use a method of blending special pigments to express plating coatings.
